contract_gaps.where: hsdd/spec/nidana.model.md, ### nidana.model.4 Scope ('topology-ir@v1's TopologyDefinition (its factory and five getters) under lib/src/ir/') against ### nidana.model.5 Scope (which lands TransformEdge, CombinatorKind, EdgeInput, TopicInput, StageInput and FunctionRef 'beside nidana.model.4's TopologyDefinition'); hsdd/contract/topology-ir.md lines 119 to 135 (TopologyDefinition) and the Delivery paragraph at line 45
contract_gaps.problem: TopologyDefinition's factory takes `required List<TransformEdge> transforms` and one of its five getters is `List<TransformEdge> get transforms`. Nothing in nidana.model.3 or nidana.model.4's Scope declares TransformEdge (nidana.model.5 does), so a package that lands the phase as scoped does not analyze: the type is undefined, and the phase gate's second command (`fvm dart analyze --fatal-infos`) fails. TransformEdge in turn names EdgeInput (TopicInput, StageInput), CombinatorKind and FunctionRef. The stand-in that confirmed the topology-dsl@v2 fixtures declares TransformEdge and CombinatorKind beside TopologyDefinition for this reason. The surface fixtures of topology-dsl@v2 touch only `definition.reads` and `definition.writes`, so the fixtures do not force the type, the declaration does. This is a plan-level inconsistency (which phase lands which declaration), not a defect in the text of topology-dsl@v2 or topology-ir@v1, and no fixture is wrong.
contract_gaps.proposed_fix: Route to hsdd-phase-plan (append or amend mode) before S109, or rule that the plan writer lands the closure in nidana.model.4. Either (a) amend nidana.model.4's Scope to name TransformEdge and the types it names (EdgeInput, TopicInput, StageInput, CombinatorKind, FunctionRef) and nidana.model.5's Scope to drop them, adjusting nidana.model.4's size (about 100 to 150 more lines of mostly dartdoc, within the 5-task cap only if the plan splits by seam), Consumes (topology-ir@v1 Interface for those types) and Collides with; or (b) leave the plans as written and let the plan writer declare that closure in lib/src/ir/ in nidana.model.4, with nidana.model.5 finding the declarations in place (its Collides with already names nidana.model.4 and lib/src/ir/). Option (b) needs no governance edit but the node plan would then understate nidana.model.4's work.
